notes.title: Effect Update - 1.0.2
notes.notes:
[h1]Welcome back all throwers and eaters[/h1]
Our second point of timeline is now out. Check out new mechanic added to the game. There have also been lot of changes and there may still be new changes, because of balancing game. In short, what changed: New effect system, items stats changes, more visual particles, fix sound effects and new item.
[hr][/hr]
[h2]New Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] Effect system
[*] New Item
[*] Changes
[*] Fixes
[/list]
[hr][/hr]
[h2]Effect system[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45295339/2c78c406174d191826299004761720095f481168.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45295339/9ad6273319939ff7729605735d529d2730949943.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Players now can get effects by eating something or get hit by someone.
[*] New 7 effects (4 Positive, 3 Negative)
[/list]
[hr][/hr]
[h2]New Item[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45295339/45598ccb84c1b576134dd69a05a40ebf063172ef.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Medicament
[/list]
[hr][/hr]
[h2]Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Loot boxes and supply drops now have 3D sound
[*] New break sound
[*] New explosion sound
[*] Banana - Heal from 45 to 40 hp, effect added
[*] Box of candles - Chance drop from supply drop from 1% to 0.5%
[*] Crystal - Damage from 24 to 22 hp, effect added
[*] Electro Machete - Damage from 42 to 38, 2 effects added
[*] Hot coal - Damage from 22 to 14 hp, effect added
[*] Poison - Damage from 31 to 26 hp, effect added
[*] Rotten apple - Heal from -4 to -1 hp, effect added
[*] Saw axe - Damage from 32 to 30 hp, effect added
[*] Sword - effect added
[/list]
[hr][/hr]
[h2]Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a Slot 10 in setting, now you can also rebind it.
[*] Fixed XP achievment
[*] Fixed fire stick particle effect stimulation space from local to world. Now the particle is not static in hand.
[/list]

notes.title: Update Timeline 1#
notes.notes:

Let me present you the Update Timeline. With that you can see order of future updates. There are not dates when they will be released. This timeline only shows what updates you can look forward. So don´t forget to check out other [b]announcements[/b], and also some updates can be split in to more releases.

[hr][/hr]
